infectious.r0.unit: secondary cases per case in a fully susceptible village
infectious.r0.note: Rash fever is an invented illness; this value is tuned for play, not taken from a real disease.

infectious.latent_weeks.note: Mean time from infection to becoming infectious.

infectious.vaccine_efficacy.unit: share of vaccinated susceptibles who become immune

infectious.initial_coverage_min.unit: share of population vaccinated at start

infectious.initial_coverage_max.unit: share of population vaccinated at start

infectious.detection_fraction.unit: share of cases that ever reach the reporting system
infectious.detection_fraction.note: Scaled by trust; raised by surveillance cards.

infectious.surveillance_detection_gain.unit: detection fraction added at full surveillance boost

infectious.overload_detection_factor.note: Applies while the block's staff are overloaded.

infectious.reporting_delay_weeks.note: Mean delay from onset to report.

infectious.surveillance_delay_reduction.unit: share of the delay removed at full surveillance boost

infectious.outbreak_threshold_reported.note: Trigger for declaring an outbreak in a village; not an official definition.

infectious.travel_rate.unit: probability per infectious person per neighbouring village per week

infectious.external_import_probability.note: Infection arriving from outside the district.

infectious.index_cases.note: Infected people in each starting village.

infectious.tracing_retained_per_week.note: How quickly a contact tracing effort fades.
